note: SAMPLE parties, practice only. Public identifiers; no key material.
words: The approver checked every one of the 40 items in the asker's batch.
1 of the 40 falls short of the agreed words; the plan accepts up to 1.
The acceptance does not cover that one.
The plan accepts the batch if at most 1 falls short.
This says what was seen in these 40 items, and nothing more.
It does not show that the items are good — only that the approver checked them and answered.
It says nothing about who made the items.
